shots.text: Ashwick was the youngest runner ever to carry the Concord's messages. He was still running when he fell. I think he had forgotten where to.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: Ashwick stumbling in the reeds, embers scattering, the satchel falling open: old letters stamped with the Concord seal blow away.

shots.text: At the heart of the burning reeds stood a tower of ice that had not melted. Inside it waited a blind girl who said she had been expecting us.
shots.speaker: narrator
shots.art_note: A tower of ice in a ring of fire; inside, Mirelle, small, pearls sewn on everything, blind eyes glowing teal, holding an ice staff with a fish frozen inside.

shots.text: You're late. Only a little. I saw that too.
shots.speaker: mirelle
shots.art_note: Mirelle stepping out onto the frost, barefoot. Joins as a hero.
